correctness.rationale: For N>=3 the coordinate ratio polytope x_i<=2x_j in sum x_i=1 has exactly two-level vertices v_S=(1+1_S)/(N+|S|), with each S nonempty and proper. For vertex sizes s,t and intersection r, the squared distance D_N(s,t,r) decreases strictly in r, reducing to minimal-overlap disjoint/covering chambers. The written strict exchange inequalities force s+t=N, r=0; along complementary pairs the objective is 9N*z/(2N^2+z)^2 with z=s(N-s), increasing up to N^2/4, so only maximally balanced complements are diametral and their counts are binomial matching counts. Symmetry and unique minimal enclosing ball locate the center at u=1/N; squared vertex distances are s(N-s)/[N(N+s)^2], with a unique discrete maximizing high-coordinate shell s=floor((N+1)/3), giving the radius/contact count and asymptotic constants. The formulas were independently checked in small N with exact fractions. Both claimed main pieces are also established in the fully read prior records, so correctness is NOT originality.
